concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-kakaopay-api-only]] — 2026-09-15 KakaoPay API-only Advanced Web redirect guide for KR/KRW discovery, ordinary versus recurring fields and token-created webhook after settlement; conditional item text, versioned examples and mixed TEST/LIVE wording are qualified in the source.
warnings: Ordinary-payment no-extra-parameters wording does not apply to the separately specified token-creation and token-charge fields or remove base Advanced request handling.
The flow mentions item information only if applicable, but provides no item schema; do not manufacture one.
The recurring token-created webhook is stated to follow settlement, not merely request, redirect or authorization.
The test section says 'test successful ... live payments' and separately points to TEST Customer Area; keep environment ambiguity visible.
TEST v72 discovery and TEST v68 recurring curl plus varying example amounts do not prove version/amount requirements or payment outcomes.
